blocks.html: Robinsons Malls and Shell Pilipinas Corporation recently unveiled the new Shell Recharge EV Charging Station at the 2nd floor parking area of Opus, the city’s newest and iconic lifestyle destination located at Bridgetowne Destination Estate Quezon City. This partnership with Shell, one of the e-mobility pioneers in the country, brings Global expertise in EV Charging solutions to decarbonize mobility and provide a sustainable, lower-carbon future in Opus Mall.

blocks.cap: Sh​​​​​ell Recharge Opus Mall has a total of 4 charging bays currently charging for free compatible with Lexus RZ450e, Mercedes Benz EQE 350+ AMG, Lexus UX300e and Mercedes Benz EQB

blocks.html: "Electrifying mobility requires collaboration between industries, and we are happy to work with Robinsons Land to provide cleaner energy solutions for our customers with Shell Recharge now available at Opus Mall," said Shell Pilipinas Country Manager for E-Mobility, Convenience Retail and Vehicle Care, Josemari Lorenzo "Jolo" Valdez.

blocks.cap: Robinsons Malls and Shell Pilipinas executives celebrate the opening of the new Shell Recharge EV Charging Station at Opus with a ribbon-cutting ceremony. (Left to Right: Robinsons Malls Team: Jess Zulueta (Senior Marketing Director), Raymie Delos Reyes (Transport Head), Lucky Jay Damaso (Corporate Energy Head), Myron Yao (Operations Director), Joel Lumanlan (VP for Operations and Marketing), Shell Pilipinas Team: Josemari Lorenzo "Jolo" Valdez (Country Manager for E-Mobility, Convenience Retail and Vehicle Care), Millicent Ngo (Global Real Estate New Fuels Portfolio Manager), Melinna Grace Tiongson (Real Estate Program Manager), Maam Argos (CBRE Business Unit Head - Transaction Management), Flaurend Atuelan (Real Estate Program Manager)

blocks.html: This collaboration highlights Robinsons Malls’ and Shell's initiatives to reduce carbon emissions and provide more sustainable lifestyles. The new Shell Recharge EV Charging Station features two AC 22kW with 2 Charge Points each, offering a total of 4 charging bays, currently offering free charging to Opus customers.

blocks.cap: Shell Pilipinas’ Jolo Valdez - Country Manager for E-Mobility, Convenience Retail and Vehicle Care and Robinsons Malls' Joel Lumanlan - VP for Operations and Marketing, ceremonially power up an EV at the new Shell Recharge EV Charging Station at Opus

blocks.html: "Today marks a pivotal moment in our sustainability journey as we launch the Shell Recharge station at

Opus, with more locations set to open in the coming months. Through this strategic partnership with Shell, Robinsons Malls continues to uphold its commitment to environmental sustainability and champion the shift to cleaner energy solutions. Together, we are driving positive change and cultivating a better, greener future for all" said Robinsons Malls' VP for Operations and Marketing, Joel Lumanlan. He adds that Shell Recharge provides a convenient charging experience in just three easy steps: Connect, Plug, and Enjoy the amenities of Opus.

Shell Recharge enables worry-free e-mobility. This new EV Charging station in Quezon City complements the Ultra-Rapid Charging stations located strategically at motorway sites at SLEX Mamplasan and TPLEX Rosario. EV Owners who shop at Opus now have more options to charge while shopping, dining or watching a movie.
